title: Scottish Music 3
description: Revise Scottish Music concepts introduced up to National 5, including instruments and features used in related Celtic music.

items.prompt: Name the type of metre represented by 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4, where each main beat divides into two equal parts. Give the metre type, not one example signature.
A Scottish dance usually in moderate simple quadruple time, characteristically using accented short-long Scotch snaps. Name the dance.
Name the North-East Scottish farm-worker song tradition, commonly sung in Scots and associated with life in farm bothies.
A fusion of Celtic or Scottish folk music with rock.
A psalm sung in Scottish Gaelic, traditionally in churches of the Western Isles.
An extended form of solo Highland bagpipe music, also called ceol mor.
A Scottish Gaelic work song sung by women while beating newly woven cloth to soften and shrink it.
Name the general term for a very short ornamental note immediately before a main note, rather than a repeated alternation of two notes.
Name the type of metre in which each main beat divides into three equal parts. In 6/8, 9/8 and 12/8 there are two, three and four main beats respectively.
A shallow Irish frame drum held in one hand and struck with a short double-ended beater.
The Scottish Gaelic harp: a small folk harp with strings plucked by the fingers.
